mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher (real_name, university, major, user_id, latitude, longitude, address, city, district, province, teacher_verification_code) VALUES (#{realName}, #{university}, #{major}, #{userId}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{address}, #{city}, #{district}, #{province}, #{teacherVerificationCode})
mapper.select: select teacher.id from teacher where user_id = #{currentUserId};

SELECT t.* FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN teacher_subject ts ON t.id = ts.teacher_id LEFT JOIN subject s ON ts.subject_id = s.id
AND t.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND s.subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%')
GROUP BY t.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN teacher_subject ts ON t.id = ts.teacher_id LEFT JOIN subject s ON ts.subject_id = s.id
AND t.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND s.subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%')
SELECT l.* FROM teacher_lesson tl INNER JOIN lesson l ON l.id = tl.lesson_id WHERE tl.teacher_id = #{teacherId}

SELECT t.*,
( 6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{userLatitude})) * cos(radians(t.latitude)) * cos(radians(t.longitude) - radians(#{userLongitude})) + sin(radians(#{userLatitude})) * sin(radians(t.latitude)) ) ) as distance,
CASE WHEN ( 6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{userLatitude})) * cos(radians(t.latitude)) * cos(radians(t.longitude) - radians(#{userLongitude})) + sin(radians(#{userLatitude})) * sin(radians(t.latitude)) ) ) <= #{searchRadius} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as isNearby FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN teacher_subject ts ON t.id = ts.teacher_id LEFT JOIN subject s ON ts.subject_id = s.id
AND t.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND s.subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%')
AND t.university LIKE CONCAT('%', #{university}, '%')
AND t.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%')
AND t.district LIKE CONCAT('%', #{district}, '%')
AND ( 6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{userLatitude})) * cos(radians(t.latitude)) * cos(radians(t.longitude) - radians(#{userLongitude})) + sin(radians(#{userLatitude})) * sin(radians(t.latitude)) ) ) <= #{searchRadius}
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ( 6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{userLatitude})) * cos(radians(t.latitude)) * cos(radians(t.longitude) - radians(#{userLongitude})) + sin(radians(#{userLatitude})) * sin(radians(t.latitude)) ) ) <= #{searchRadius} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, distance ASC
ORDER BY t.university ASC, t.real_name ASC
LIMIT #{page}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN teacher_subject ts ON t.id = ts.teacher_id LEFT JOIN subject s ON ts.subject_id = s.id
AND t.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND s.subject_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{subject}, '%')
AND t.university LIKE CONCAT('%', #{university}, '%')
AND t.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%')
AND t.district LIKE CONCAT('%', #{district}, '%')
AND ( 6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{userLatitude})) * cos(radians(t.latitude)) * cos(radians(t.longitude) - radians(#{userLongitude})) + sin(radians(#{userLatitude})) * sin(radians(t.latitude)) ) ) <= #{searchRadius}
mapper.update: UPDATE teacher SET latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, address = #{address}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, province = #{province} WHERE id = #{id}
